title: Module E — API Request Contracts
description: Inbound payloads the frontend sends to the backend. These are the two entry points of the system: a student registering their GitHub account (feeds Pipeline A) and a recruiter submitting a raw JD (starts Pipeline B).

student_registration.description: POST /students. Triggers ingestion for the account's public repositories.

github_username.description: GitHub's own username rules: alphanumeric plus single internal hyphens, max 39 chars.

repo_urls.description: Optional explicit repo list. When omitted, ingestion enumerates the account's public repositories.

consent.description: Student agrees to have their public repositories analysed. Required — the pipeline must not run without it.

job_submission.description: POST /jobs. The raw JD text goes straight to Genie — the backend does no skill extraction of its own.

job_id.description: Omitted on create; assigned by the backend.

jd_text.description: Unmodified job description. Passed verbatim to the Recruitment Genie agent.

registered_student_ids.description: Candidates who applied for this job. Retrieval is restricted to this set.

policy_overrides.description: Optional per-job requirement weights. Absent means the default 1.0 / 0.6 / 0.3 policy.
